newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH BICS100 BOND INDEX RISES 0.003PTS TO 103.286.
newsitem.headline: CZECH BICS100 BOND INDEX RISES 0.003PTS TO 103.286.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.003 points in Tuesday's trading to 103.286 points, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.788 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, fell 0.050 points to 100.909, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.329 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 rose 0.586 points to 1,023.621.
